facts.fact: Malijet reports that at the launch of phase III of the African Girls Can Code Initiative on 2 October 2025 the programme was described as anchored in the national policy for the development of the digital economy, whose ambition is to make Mali a digital-technology excellence in West Africa over 2021-2034 with a digitalised administration.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement de l'économie numérique (PNDEN)

note: Press report of a launch; it states the policy's period but does not say whether its text is public, so 'current' rests on the stated 2021-2034 period alone. Class national is taken from the stated ambition (economy plus a digitalised administration).
